summary: Lane reports cover their declared evidence obligations and retain reported or legacy_unavailable origin. Executable finding resolutions require durably bound evidence or qualifying current-subject receipts; independently_executed controls require independent bound evidence. Main's acceptance of the exact current Review closes declared judged findings atomically with Review-state findings. Mixed findings owe both proof sets. Citations remain rationale, not native receipts. Dispatch pins schema and identity, and the adapter strips identity echoes. Older completions retain legacy_unavailable origin. Workers gain no workflow verdict or completion authority.
title: A lane report discharges its lane's evidence obligations
